claim: E4.5 desktop entry + URL-handler registration (clash evidence)

AppImage-written entry (remnant observed at ~/.local/share/applications/zcode.desktop, re-written by the running app): Name=ZCode, Exec="<path-to>/ZCode-3.18.2-linux-x64.AppImage" %U, MimeType=x-scheme-handler/zcode;, StartupWMClass=ZCode, Categories=Development

deb-packaged entry (read from the artifact, single-member tar read — no extraction): Name=ZCode, Exec=/opt/ZCode/zcode %U, MimeType=x-scheme-handler/zcode;, StartupWMClass=ZCode — same filename zcode.desktop, same URL-handler scheme, different Exec target

DEB-VS-APPIMAGE CLASH CONFIRMED BY ARTIFACTS: both layouts install a zcode.desktop registering x-scheme-handler/zcode with mutually exclusive Exec targets (AppImage file vs /opt/ZCode/zcode). The xdg default decides which binary opens zcode:// URLs: on this machine xdg-mime query default x-scheme-handler/zcode -> zcode.desktop backed by the AppImage-pointing user-level entry (mimeapps.list row x-scheme-handler/zcode=zcode.desktop). Installing the deb after the AppImage (or vice versa) can silently repoint URL handling — discovery must resolve the ACTUAL Exec target behind the default rather than assuming either layout. Side-effect observed on this machine: text/html is also mapped to zcode.desktop in mimeapps.list (the desktop registered itself as default browser)
evidence: both desktop entries + live xdg-mime query
